items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being reminded that staff awareness alone isn't enough to stop cyber threats — stronger technical controls need to be in place too. Separately, a warning has been issued about document redaction: poorly redacted files can still expose sensitive information, a risk relevant to any organisation sharing documents with clients or regulators. Businesses handling payments should also be aware of a growing blind spot around internal fraud, with staff often having more access than necessary.

**Practical tip:** Before sharing any redacted document externally, copy the text into a plain text editor to check whether hidden information can still be retrieved.

featured.title: Businesses urged to add stronger controls beyond vigilance
featured.summary: Rising scam losses are pushing Australian firms towards stronger payment and login controls as regulators prepare tougher enforcement.
